Sub: Payment through NEFT - Reg.
Sir,

Please refer to this office letter No. ACC (IS)/PS/Misc/SMS/2010/126 dated
07.06.2011 (placed on website at office order and circulars 2011-2012 at SI. No. 136),

wherein it was requested that all offices to work towards a target of 100% of claim
settlement using NEFT mode of payment.

2. However, as per the information available at EPFO Dashboard of claim settlement,
it is found that since April 2012, payment to members through NEFT is only 76.22%.
Offices where NEFT payment is below 75% are enclosed as Annexure ‘A’

3. It is reiterated that NEFT payment mode has been introduced with the intention of

speedy payment and easy reconciliation.

4. You are therefore, once again requested to pay personal attention and ensure that
the claims are settled through NEFT payments only.

Yours faithfully,

(e=reete

(B.K. Panda)
